from our own Anthropologie, Free People and Urban Outfitters family.

Find XXS-5X, plus, petite, tall, adaptive + maternity assortments

### Pause or cancel anytime

No commitments—Nuuly was built for flexibility. Pause or cancel whenever you’d like.

### Fast, free shipping + returns

We’ll notify you at every step of your Nuuly’s journey by email, text or both—you can also check its
status any time onsite.

### Laundry + dry cleaning included

Never get bogged down by stains or laundry again. Send it back +  we’ll take care of it.

it’s not making the return trip.

charged is sales tax where applicable.

# Free Online Games at CrazyGames

CrazyGames features the latest and best free online games. You can enjoy playing fun games without
interruptions from downloads, intrusive ads, or pop-ups. Just load up your favorite games instantly
in your web browser and enjoy the experience.

You can play our games on desktop and mobile devices. That includes everything from desktop PCs,
laptops, and Chromebooks, to the latest smartphones and tablets from Apple and Android. You can also
install CrazyGames as a mobile app, both on [Android][66] and on [iOS][67].

## About CrazyGames

There are plenty of online multiplayer games with active communities on CrazyGames. You can find
many of the best free multiplayer titles on our[ .io games ][68]page. In these games, you can play
with your friends online and with other people from around the world, no matter where you are.

## Play our Best Games

CrazyGames has over 4,500 fun games in every genre you can imagine. Some of our most popular games
are:
* [Shell Shockers][69]
* [Agar io][70]
* [Uno Online][71]
* [Geometry Dash][72]
* [Moto X3M][73]
* [Smash Karts][74]
* [GeoGuessr][75]
* [Hangman][76]

## Explore by Genre

You’ll find the main categories like [clicker][77], [driving games][78], and [shooting games][79] at
the top of any page, but there’s also a range of subcategories that will help you find the perfect
game. Popular tags include [car games][80], [Minecraft][81], [2-player games][82], [match 3
games][83], and [mahjong.][84]

## Suggest a Game

Is there a game that you love, but you can't find on CrazyGames? [Suggest a game][85] to us, and
we'll see what we can do to get it. You can also [contact us][86] for any general suggestions or
improvements.

## About CrazyGames

CrazyGames is a free browser gaming platform founded in 2014 by Raf Mertens. Since then, the
platform has grown to over 30 million monthly users.

Our mission is simple: to create a browser-gaming platform that works seamlessly for users around
the world and rewards developers both big and small. Visit our corporate site and learn more [about
CrazyGames][87].

FAQs
What is EPROLO?
EPROLO is a leading dropshipping supplier and a forever-free platform designed to empower e-commerce
entrepreneurs. We streamline your entire dropshipping business by handling everything from global
product sourcing and inventory management to seamless order fulfillment.
Our services are uniquely enhanced by premium branding options, helping you build a distinctive and
scalable brand. Trusted by a global community of over 1.6 million dropshippers, EPROLO provides all
the essential dropshipping tools you need to compete and win in today's competitive online
marketplaces.
Is it free to use EPROLO? Is there any hidden cost?
EPROLO operates on an open "forever free" policy, where we do not charge any membership fee, monthly
subscription fee, or any other kind of hidden fee. You only need to pay for the product and delivery
fee when you place the order with EPROLO. This allows you to start and establish your dropshipping
business without cost of stock.
What are your delivery time frame? Do you offer a shipping guarantee?
EPROLO offers multiple international Express Shipping Options for efficient global delivery, within
7-15 days. For added a peace of mind, we offer a 30-day [shipping guarantee][77] - if your order
doesn't arrive after 30 days, you will get a full refund.
Can I customize the package or brand my products with no minimum order quantity?
Yes, absolutely! This is indeed one of the strongest and most unique benefits of EPROLO. We offer
one-stop [branding services][78] like personalized labels, hangtags, packaging, gift cards, and
scotch tapes with no minimum order quantity (MOQ).Game-changer for small businesses: You can build a
pro brand image right from your very first sale.[Check out][79] for more information about the
brading project.
Which eCommerce platforms does EPROLO support?
We connect with all the big names:[ Shopify][80], [WooCommerce][81],[ Wix][82],[ Amazon][83],[
eBay][84], Etsy, plus [TikTok Shop][85],[ AliExpress][86],[ Shoplazza][87] and [SHOPLINE][88]. Setup
is super easy - just plug and play. Need something custom? [EPROLO API][89]'s got you covered.
How does EPROLO handle quality control and stock management?
EPROLO has its own [warehouses US, UK, China][90], and other key locations, holding inventory and
providing shipping directly . Our quality control team personally checks each item to make sure it
meets standards. Plus, we’ll email you as soon as possible if something sells out, so you can keep
your store updated.
What kind of customer support does EPROLO offer?
EPROLO provides excellent customer service to assist you whenever you need it. Visit our
comprehensive [Help Center][91] to find answers to general questions, or reach out via our support
email for personalized help. We're happy to assist you with everything - from setting up your online
store to choosing shipping options, checking rates, and fulfilling orders.
What is the size of the product range available at EPROLO?
EPROLO offers over one million dropshipping products across 107 specialized categories, such as
Fashion and Clothing, Sports and Outdoors, Beauty and Health etc. providing you a wide variety of
options for your niche. We also serve as a dropshipping sourcing agent, connecting you with major
e-commerce platforms and working with trusted supply chains to ensure product reliability and
diversity.

FAQs
What is EPROLO?
EPROLO is a leading dropshipping supplier and a forever-free platform designed to empower e-commerce
entrepreneurs. We streamline your entire dropshipping business by handling everything from global
product sourcing and inventory management to seamless order fulfillment.
Our services are uniquely enhanced by premium branding options, helping you build a distinctive and
scalable brand. Trusted by a global community of over 1.6 million dropshippers, EPROLO provides all
the essential dropshipping tools you need to compete and win in today's competitive online
marketplaces.
Is it free to use EPROLO? Is there any hidden cost?
EPROLO operates on an open "forever free" policy, where we do not charge any membership fee, monthly
subscription fee, or any other kind of hidden fee. You only need to pay for the product and delivery
fee when you place the order with EPROLO. This allows you to start and establish your dropshipping
business without cost of stock.
What are your delivery time frame? Do you offer a shipping guarantee?
EPROLO offers multiple international Express Shipping Options for efficient global delivery, within
7-15 days. For added a peace of mind, we offer a 30-day [shipping guarantee][77] - if your order
doesn't arrive after 30 days, you will get a full refund.
Can I customize the package or brand my products with no minimum order quantity?
Yes, absolutely! This is indeed one of the strongest and most unique benefits of EPROLO. We offer
one-stop [branding services][78] like personalized labels, hangtags, packaging, gift cards, and
scotch tapes with no minimum order quantity (MOQ).Game-changer for small businesses: You can build a
pro brand image right from your very first sale.[Check out][79] for more information about the
brading project.
Which eCommerce platforms does EPROLO support?
We connect with all the big names:[ Shopify][80], [WooCommerce][81],[ Wix][82],[ Amazon][83],[
eBay][84], Etsy, plus [TikTok Shop][85],[ AliExpress][86],[ Shoplazza][87] and [SHOPLINE][88]. Setup
is super easy - just plug and play. Need something custom? [EPROLO API][89]'s got you covered.
How does EPROLO handle quality control and stock management?
EPROLO has its own [warehouses US, UK, China][90], and other key locations, holding inventory and
providing shipping directly . Our quality control team personally checks each item to make sure it
meets standards. Plus, we’ll email you as soon as possible if something sells out, so you can keep
your store updated.
What kind of customer support does EPROLO offer?
EPROLO provides excellent customer service to assist you whenever you need it. Visit our
comprehensive [Help Center][91] to find answers to general questions, or reach out via our support
email for personalized help. We're happy to assist you with everything - from setting up your online
store to choosing shipping options, checking rates, and fulfilling orders.
What is the size of the product range available at EPROLO?
EPROLO offers over one million dropshipping products across 107 specialized categories, such as
Fashion and Clothing, Sports and Outdoors, Beauty and Health etc. providing you a wide variety of
options for your niche. We also serve as a dropshipping sourcing agent, connecting you with major
e-commerce platforms and working with trusted supply chains to ensure product reliability and
diversity.

## What is an image to text converter?

An Image to Text Converter is an online OCR ([Optical character recognition][44]) tool that extracts
text from images and converts it into editable text. This means you can easily copy, paste, and edit
text from images, such as JPGs and PNGs, without the hassle of manual typing.

Gone are the days of tedious manual text entry. 😫

Our advanced Image to Text Converter uses state-of-the-art OCR technology to quickly and accurately
extract text from images, saving you time and effort. 🤩

## How does our photo to text converter work?

To extract text from the image, whether it is JPG, JPEG, or PNG, follow the simple steps below.
1. Drag and Drop or upload your image using the “choose file” button.
2. Press the [Extract Now][45] button.
3. Now, please sit back and let our OCR automatically extract text from your JPG image.
4. In the next second, you can download your extracted text in .txt format.

## Discover fun games to play online


Welcome to Kizi! We've got you thousands upon thousands of amazing free online games to play now,
from [Stickman games][253] to [word games][254]. You can access all of our games via your browser
window, no downloads required! Join a great community of more than 30 million online players, with
whom you can play in multiplayer modes such as [.io games][255]. The moment you visit our home page,
you'll see all of our most popular titles and the newest additions pop up on your screen, with handy
pictures to give you a sense of the game right away. Check out the sidebar to browse all of our
player favorites by category. All of the games on our website come with walkthrough / tutorial
videos to help you get started, or to assist with tips and strategies you when you encounter a
particularly difficult level. We've also got an amazing mobile site so that you can access our games
on the go, or download our handy Kizi app. Enjoy your instant access to the best free games
available online on any platform!

## Free online games for Mobile, Desktop and Tablet


Life is even more fun when you can access your favorite games on the go. Play wherever and whenever
you like via Kizi Mobile. No downloads, just fun online games! Kizi mobile can be accessed via your
Android phone, iPhone, tablet, and other mobile devices. The mobile site is easy to navigate, with
new games popping up at the top, and a category bar to help you explore our vast games collection.
Experience the most realistic 3D stunt games, fantastic MMO titles, [fighting][256], [gun
games][257], HTML adventure and puzzle games across a range of different platforms. We also have a
great selection of online [games for kids][258], including typing and [math games][259]. Parents
will find our mobile portal just as safe, secure, and child-friendly as our main Kizi.com web
portal.

## Popular games for everyone at your fingertips


At Kizi, we also develop our own game titles, and you can access these games along with a selection
of the most popular online games via our apps. Want to access games directly on mobile via a
trusted, 100% safe and child-friendly app with no in-game purchases? Download the Kizi app from the
Play Store and join over 10 million players enjoying the top picks from our catalogue of racing
games, puzzles, cooking, action, RPG and dress-up games, and much more! You can also pick up our
free game apps Kiziland, Kizi Adventures, and more original Kizi titles. At Kizi, the fun never

# Your Competitors Are Shipping Faster. We Fix That.

Mobian builds dedicated engineering teams that deliver production-ready software — on time, on
budget, without the cost of a bad hire.

[ Explore Our Solutions ][6]

Mobian Studio is a European software development partner specializing in Mobile and AI solutions for
companies in IT, Healthcare, Fintech, and Logistics.

We operate two models: outsourcing (we own delivery end-to-end) and outstaffing (our engineers join
your team). Either way, you get senior-level execution without the overhead of building in-house.

[ About Us ][7]

What we do

We design, build, and scale digital products for companies that cannot afford to get the technology
wrong.

Two ways to work with us:

**Outsourcing** — You hand us the project. We build the team, manage delivery, and ship
production-ready software. You stay focused on your business.

**Outstaffing** — You keep control. We embed senior engineers directly into your existing team,
filling skill gaps without the cost or risk of a full hire.

Both models come with the same standard: clean architecture, documented code, and engineers who
communicate in plain English.

How We Deliver:

01

Dedicated Teams

One team. One project. No context switching, no shared developers, no excuses. Your engineers work
exclusively on your product.

02

Full-Stack Delivery

Mobile apps, AI systems, enterprise backends. We scope it, build it, and hand it over with
documentation that your team can actually use.

03

Legacy Integration

We connect new systems to what you already run. No "rip and replace" unless that's truly the right
call.

04

Post-Launch Partnership

We stay after delivery. Bug warranty, scaling support, and a team that already knows your codebase
when you need to move fast.

Our expertise:

01

End-to-End Product Development

From wireframes to production deployment. We cover mobile (iOS, Android, Flutter), backend, APIs,
cloud infrastructure, and QA — so you don't need five different vendors.

02

AI & Automation Systems

Custom AI agents, private knowledge base assistants, computer vision, and LLM-powered workflows.
Built for your data, secured for your environment.

03

Scalable Architecture

We design systems that handle 100 users today and 100,000 users next year — without a full rebuild
when you grow. Every architecture decision is documented and explainable.

04

Domain Expertise in IT, Healthcare, Fintech & Logistics

Regulatory compliance, HL7/FHIR integrations, payment flows, route optimization — we've built in
your industry before and we know the constraints that matter.

# Free Online OCR Convert JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, PDF, DjVu to Text

Our free online OCR service allows you to quickly and easily convert scanned documents and images
into editable text, with no limits on the number of files you can upload. There's no need to
register for an account or install any software, making it easy to start using our OCR service right
away. Whether you need to extract text from a PDF, image, or other document, our OCR service is here
to help you work more efficiently. Try it now and see how our OCR service can make your life easier!
Choose your file for OCR processing
Preview 

### Features

Free online OCR service offers unlimited file uploads and does not require registration. Your data
is kept safe and secure with us, and all of your files will be removed from the server after use for
added privacy. Our service is based on the Tesseract OCR engine and supports 122 recognition
languages and fonts, making it ideal for multi-language recognition. It is also capable of
recognizing mathematical equations and analyzing page layouts for improved text recognition. You can
select a specific area on a page for OCR and rotate pages clockwise or counterclockwise in 90°, 180°
increments. After OCR processing, you have several options for displaying and processing the
resulting text, including downloading as a file, editing in Google Docs, translating with Google
Translate or Bing Translator, publishing online, copying to the clipboard, and more. Our service is
even able to handle poorly scanned and photographed pages and low-resolution images.


### Input file formats

Free online OCR service is able to process a wide range of input file formats, including popular
image formats such as JPEG, JFIF, PNG, GIF, BMP, PBM, PGM, PPM, and PCX. We can also handle
compressed files like Unix compress, bzip2, bzip, and gzip. For multi-page documents, we support
TIFF, PDF, and DjVu formats. In addition, our service is able to handle DOCX and ODT files with
images and multiple images within a ZIP archive, making it a versatile tool for all of your OCR
needs.


### Output file formats

Free online OCR service provides a variety of output file formats to meet your needs. Choose from
plain text (TXT), Microsoft Word (DOC), or Adobe Acrobat (PDF). No matter which format you choose,
you can trust that the resulting text will be accurate and easy to work with. Whether you need a
simple text document, a fully formatted Word document, or a professional-grade PDF, our OCR service
has you covered.

### Recognition languages

Free online OCR service offers recognition in a wide variety of languages, including Afrikaans,
Amharic, Arabic, Assamese, Azerbaijani, Belarusian, Bengali, Tibetan, Bosnian, Breton, Bulgarian,
Catalan, Valencian, Cebuano, Czech, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Cherokee, Welsh, Danish,
German, Dzongkha, Greek (Modern and Ancient), English, Esperanto, Estonian, Basque, Persian,
Finnish, French, Frankish, Irish, Galician, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hebrew, Hindi, Croatian,
Hungarian, Inuktitut, Indonesian, Icelandic, Italian, Javanese, Japanese, Kannada, Georgian, Kazakh,
Central Khmer, Kirghiz, Korean, Kurdish, Lao, Latin, Latvian, Lithuanian, Luxembourgish, Malayalam,
Marathi, Macedonian, Maltese, Mongolian, Maori, Malay, Burmese, Nepali, Dutch, Norwegian, Occitan,
Oriya, Panjabi, Polish, Portuguese, Pushto, Quechua, Romanian, Russian, Sanskrit, Sinhala, Slovak,
Slovenian, Sindhi, Spanish, Albanian, Serbian, Sundanese, Swahili, Swedish, Syriac, Tamil, Tatar,
Telugu, Tajik, Tagalog, Thai, Tigrinya, Tonga, Turkish, Uighur, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese,
Yiddish, and Yoruba. In addition, we offer a math/equation detection module for your specialized OCR
needs.

## How to convert Image to Text?

### 1. Upload Image

Upload JPG Image or PDF document for conversion. You can upload any type of input images or
documents, such as PDF, Tiff, PNG, BMP, JPEG and other.

### 2. Convert

Click the “Convert” button and our Picture to Text Converter will automatically extract text from
images and convert it into editable text.

### 3. Download

Download converted editable file by clicking on the link or copy extracted text into clipboard

[OCR Technology]

## Image to Text Converter – what is this?


Image to text converter is the Online OCR tool based on Optical character recognition technology.
Use our service to extract text and characters from scanned PDF documents (including multipage
files), photos and digital camera captured images.

If you need to convert picture to text or extract text from a photo, use our image to word
converter. If you have a scanned book in PDF format and want to create a searchable PDF, our service
is the best solution to convert PDF to Word or Excel!

You don't need to waste time rewriting a scanned lecture - just upload the scanned JPG and convert
image to text.

Using advanced image pre-processing algorithms and OCR technology, our service scans text from your
images and extracts it to any editable format.

## OCR tool – use cases

The image to Word converter has many uses
* This allows us to extract text from scanned JPG or PDF documents
* It creates searchable, editable and accessible content
* Additionally, some options for using image to text are described below:

[OCR tools use cases]

### Searchable PDF

The most useful feature is converting a scanned PDF into a searchable PDF. This option allows you to
quickly find the necessary information in the extracted text. This function is often used by
libraries and government agencies to digitize their archives.

### Education

Teachers and students can convert scanned study notes, textbooks and lecture notes into text for
better exam preparation. Scanned lectures takes a lot of space on your hard drive or phone. The
text-based version, created via image to text converter takes up much less space.

### Book Digitization

Book digitization is the process of converting physical books, magazines and other records into
digital media using an image to word converter. As content digitizes, more and more publishers and
organizations are digitizing their physical books into text formats such as PDF/A for easy
distribution and reproduction in the online space. These digitized books can then be read on a
digital screen. The editable format helps reduce file size and allows third-party applications to
search, reformat, or manipulate text.

### Data mining

Data mining is the process of extracting and discovering patterns in large data sets using methods
that intersect machine learning, statistics, and database systems. Image to text conversion is the
first step in preparing structured information to data mining set.

### Data extraction

It is used to extract text from invoices, receipts, tables, forms and other documents to create
databases and spreadsheets.

### Quick translation

When you see something in an unknown language, you can simply take a photo, send it to our image to
text conversion service, and once processed, send the extracted data to the translator.

### Legislation and Compliance

Typically, legal documents are got in scanned form. Using picture to text converter you can extract
important information from legal documents, contracts, invoices or government docs. Image to text
converter gives you the ability to convert scanned documents into digital versions.

WAY TO AIRPORT
 
Car Rental Services at Phuket Airport
Car Rental Services at Phuket Airport For passengers arriving at Phuket Airport who wish to travel
into the city or continue their journey while maintaining privacy, speed, and safety, the airport
offers various car rental services. These services are available on the first floor of the airport.
Here are the car rental companies available at Phuket Airport: Passengers can book car rentals in
advance at special prices and claim privileges from various car rental brands through the Sawasdee
by AOT Application, available on both *When traveling to airports, passengers should allow at least
2 hours in advance to ensure timely boarding, as there are quite a few procedures involved.
Alternatively, booking a hotel near the airport for a night’s stay can also be a convenient
option.
[READ MORE ][22]
How to get to Phuket Airport
How to get to Phuket Airport Car / Airport Shuttle For passengers who want to travel to Phuket
Airport or tourists who board a flight back to Bangkok, they can easily book the airport shuttle
service in advance for convenience and speed. Tourists who use the rental car service can return the
car at the front car rental counter at Phuket Airport. Airport Bus For those who don't like to
drive. Airport buses are a very good option. There are stops covering people throughout the city,
and there are buses leaving every hour. The schedule is clear, suitable for people who have time to
spare and do not have a lot of luggage, and it is available in front of the exit of the arrival hall
and the station until the 1st passenger drop-off. Details are as follows: Phuket Airport –
City 8.15 – 20.15 hrs. City – Phuket Airport 9.15 – 21.15 hrs. Bus Route : Same
route to and from the airport – Indigo Pearl Hotel – Wat Phra Nang Sang – Thao
Thep Monument – Boat Lagoon – Premium Outlet – Irrawaddy Bypass – Tesco
Lotus Intersection Big C – Central – Surakul Stadium – Panthep Condo Town –
Merlin Hotel Intersection – Phuket Women's School Intersection – Old Bus Station (City)
Airport Bus Express The service is available in front of the exit of the arrival hall and the
station until the 1st passenger drop-off is also available, with the following details: Airport
– Patong Beach 08.00 – 20.00 hrs. Patong Beach - Airport 06.00 – 18.30 hrs. Bus
route : The same route to and from the airport – Fort Muang Mai – Thalang – Lotus
Thalang – Tha Pier – Boat Lagoon – Lotus Sabai Pass – Kathu Intersection
– Patong Beach Phuket Smart Bus Pleases tourists who want to travel to the beaches. In Phuket,
the Smart Bus service can be used at the Domestic Terminal, which is close to the arrival exit,
suitable for tourists who book beach accommodations or backpackers who want to experience Phuket's
famous beaches. Bus route : Phuket Airport – Sukthalang Public Office – Ban Kian -Boat
Avenue Choeng Talay - Tesco Lotus Cherng Talay – Surin Beach – Kamala Beach –
Phuket Fanta Sea – Big C Kamala – Patong Beach – Karon Beach – Kata Beach
– Saiyuan – Rawai Beach *Allow time for travel as the queue will only be available for
hours as scheduled. Public Passenger Vans For people who travel alone or want to enter the city
without having to stop a lot, a van is the most suitable because it can be flexible. Do not leave
the car around and only stop at important beaches, namely Phuket Airport – Patong Beach
– Kata Beach – Karon Beach.

WAY TO AIRPORT
 
Car Rental Services at Phuket Airport
Car Rental Services at Phuket Airport For passengers arriving at Phuket Airport who wish to travel
into the city or continue their journey while maintaining privacy, speed, and safety, the airport
offers various car rental services. These services are available on the first floor of the airport.
Here are the car rental companies available at Phuket Airport: Passengers can book car rentals in
advance at special prices and claim privileges from various car rental brands through the Sawasdee
by AOT Application, available on both *When traveling to airports, passengers should allow at least
2 hours in advance to ensure timely boarding, as there are quite a few procedures involved.
Alternatively, booking a hotel near the airport for a night’s stay can also be a convenient
option.
[READ MORE ][22]
How to get to Phuket Airport
How to get to Phuket Airport Car / Airport Shuttle For passengers who want to travel to Phuket
Airport or tourists who board a flight back to Bangkok, they can easily book the airport shuttle
service in advance for convenience and speed. Tourists who use the rental car service can return the
car at the front car rental counter at Phuket Airport. Airport Bus For those who don't like to
drive. Airport buses are a very good option. There are stops covering people throughout the city,
and there are buses leaving every hour. The schedule is clear, suitable for people who have time to
spare and do not have a lot of luggage, and it is available in front of the exit of the arrival hall
and the station until the 1st passenger drop-off. Details are as follows: Phuket Airport –
City 8.15 – 20.15 hrs. City – Phuket Airport 9.15 – 21.15 hrs. Bus Route : Same
route to and from the airport – Indigo Pearl Hotel – Wat Phra Nang Sang – Thao
Thep Monument – Boat Lagoon – Premium Outlet – Irrawaddy Bypass – Tesco
Lotus Intersection Big C – Central – Surakul Stadium – Panthep Condo Town –
Merlin Hotel Intersection – Phuket Women's School Intersection – Old Bus Station (City)
Airport Bus Express The service is available in front of the exit of the arrival hall and the
station until the 1st passenger drop-off is also available, with the following details: Airport
– Patong Beach 08.00 – 20.00 hrs. Patong Beach - Airport 06.00 – 18.30 hrs. Bus
route : The same route to and from the airport – Fort Muang Mai – Thalang – Lotus
Thalang – Tha Pier – Boat Lagoon – Lotus Sabai Pass – Kathu Intersection
– Patong Beach Phuket Smart Bus Pleases tourists who want to travel to the beaches. In Phuket,
the Smart Bus service can be used at the Domestic Terminal, which is close to the arrival exit,
suitable for tourists who book beach accommodations or backpackers who want to experience Phuket's
famous beaches. Bus route : Phuket Airport – Sukthalang Public Office – Ban Kian -Boat
Avenue Choeng Talay - Tesco Lotus Cherng Talay – Surin Beach – Kamala Beach –
Phuket Fanta Sea – Big C Kamala – Patong Beach – Karon Beach – Kata Beach
– Saiyuan – Rawai Beach *Allow time for travel as the queue will only be available for
hours as scheduled. Public Passenger Vans For people who travel alone or want to enter the city
without having to stop a lot, a van is the most suitable because it can be flexible. Do not leave
the car around and only stop at important beaches, namely Phuket Airport – Patong Beach
– Kata Beach – Karon Beach.

### Still trying to figure it out?

#### Can I cancel a booking?

+
You can cancel your booking, but your refund depends on when you cancel and whether the landlord has
approved your request. ✔️ Before the landlord approves your booking You can cancel at any time and
no charges will be incurred. ✔️ After the landlord has approved your booking Your refund is based on
how early you cancel: Full refund of the initial payment if you cancel 60 days or more before
check-in. 50% refund of the initial payment if you cancel 30–59 days before check-in. No refund if
you cancel 29 days or less before check-in. ⚠️ Important The Spotahome fee is non-refundable once
the booking is confirmed.

#### Can I visit a property before I book?

+
No, but the beauty of booking with us is that you don’t have to. Our team verify the properties for
you, leaving you more time to plan, pack, or just relax.

#### Who will I be living with?

+
We have tenants of all ages and nationalities in our properties, but we cannot share their details
with you for privacy reasons.

#### What is a Homechecker?

+
Homecheckers are people that verify properties for you. They create the digital floor plans, video
tours, and photos you see on our listings. You can trust a Homechecker. They’re your eyes and ears
in each of our cities as they live there. And we give them weekly feedback to help them, help you.
In Belgium, our Homecheckers only operate online.

#### My booking has been accepted, now what?

+
You’ll pay your Spotahome fee and first rental payment. This money will stay safe until after you
move in. We’ll also put you in contact with your landlord so you can organise a check in time. The
only other thing for you to do is relax – you’re on the move!

#### What happens if I don’t like the property I’ve moved into?

+
You have 24hrs to let us know if everything is okay. If you think you’ve been missold to, or our
listing was significantly different to what you got, we’ll help you find somewhere else to live. If
there are more serious issues, we can help cover the cost of a hotel, or refund your money if
necessary.

#### Is Spotahome safe?

+
Spotahome is a safe platform where more than 120K people have found their new home completely
online, sustaining always more than 4 out of 5 stars rating on trustpilot. At Spotahome, we put our
heart into making your life easier to take away your worry:
* We verify the properties for you and take honest photos and videos accompanied by an accurate
  description, for you to make the best and safe decision.
* Our system guarantees you a great experience with secure payments 24hr after arrival protection.
  We’ll only transfer your rent to the landlord after you give us the go-ahead, and a cancellation
  policy comes as standard, among other guarantees.
* Innovation is another hallmark for us, being the first to launch a no deposit service that
  facilitates your entry to the house of your dreams and protects the landlord in case of
  non-payments or damages.

#### How can I get my deposit refunded by Spotahome in “deposit-protected” properties?

+
To receive your rental deposit refund from Spotahome, follow these steps:
* Document the property: Take clear photos or videos when you move in and again before you move out.
* Maintain the property: Keep everything clean and in the condition you found it.
* Respect your rental contract: Follow all terms, including move-in and move-out dates.
* Pay all bills: Ensure there are no outstanding payments to your landlord.
If you complete these steps, Spotahome guarantees to refund your deposit within 3 months.

#### What should I do if there is a dispute about my deposit in “deposit-protected” properties?

+
If there’s a dispute over your rental deposit, here’s what to do:
* Document the property's condition: Take photos or videos when you move out and upload them through
  your account.
* Fulfill the contract terms: Make sure you’ve met all requirements, including the correct move-in
  and move-out dates.
* Confirm all bills are paid: Unpaid bills can delay your deposit refund.
If your deposit is withheld despite meeting these conditions, contact Spotahome support immediately.
Note: Deposit refund timelines may vary by country. If all steps are completed, Spotahome will
return your deposit within 3 months.

#### Is my rental deposit safe with Spotahome?

+
Yes, your rental deposit is safe with Spotahome if:
* The property is labelled as "deposit protected". These are the properties where Spotahome covers
  the deposit
* Comply with your rental agreement, including check-in and check-out dates
* Maintain the property's original condition
* Pay all required bills

#### Why should I choose Spotahome for short- to mid-term rentals?

+
Spotahome offers a safe and transparent way to rent short- and mid-term housing. Here’s why:

# THE WORLD’S SMARTEST 3D FASHION DESIGN SOFTWARE

Tailornova is a patent-pending online fashion design software that helps you create unlimited
designs easier and faster than ever. Visualize your creations in 3D and get custom-fitted patterns
in seconds.
[ Design now ][11]
Who needs it
DIY Sewing Community
Fashion Students
Fashion Merchandisers
Clothing Boutiques
Tailors & Dressmakers
Indie Designers
Apparel Brands
Pattern Retailers
Specialty Apparel Manufacturers
Design a complete fashion collection in minutes.
From sketches to 3D samples to patterns, instant smart fashion design templates allow you to create
original designs with a single click in seconds. They allow previewing 3D garment samples, flat
sketches and made-to-measure sewing patterns, ready to download, cut and sew.
“Tailornova has given me the opportunity to have great patterns at my fingertips for my fashion
line. Without it, I would have spent countless hours on patterns, grading and fit. I am beyond
excited to be one of their loyal subscribers! This program is a real game changer for the fashion
industry!”
Myrda J, Fashion Designer
Customize Your 3D FitModel™
It all begins with a body and your measurements. You can customize your own true-to-life 3D
FitModel™ тo replicate any figure, measurements, height, and a body shape. Customizing the 3D
FitModel™ will allow automatic creation and customization of unlimited designs and Made-To-Measure
patterns in seconds, effortlessly and with precision.
“The development of Tailornova is revolutionary for anyone in the fashion industry and has been a
pivotal tool in the growth of my manufacturing & product development team, by cutting down the
design development process by more than half the time.”
Rebecca Cahua, D.a.D Sewing House
SEAMLESS AUTOMATION OF ON-DEMAND MANUFACTURING
Your Own StyleCustomizer™ App
Effortlessly create your own StyleCustomizer™ and add to an existent e-commerce website
Sell Bespoke Fashion
Offer your designs bespoke so that they fit your customers’ unique bodies and tastes
Automated MTM Patterns
Our web platform seamlessly receives measurements and order details from your website and generates
MTM patterns&cut sheets
Print/Plot, Cut and Sew On Demand
Print at home or on a plotter to:
- cut and sew,
- laser cut for sewing bots.
Or import patterns into CAD.

PDF24 offers you a collection of tools that you can use to work productively with PDFs and other

you cannot do with PDF24.

### Easy to use

The PDF24 tools were developed to be as easy to use as possible. Intuitive usability was the goal.
We have achieved this goal and that is why the PDF24 tools are so popular.

### Safety is important to us

File transfers to the PDF24 servers are encrypted. All files are completely removed from our servers
after a short time. If you want to be even more secure, you can use the [PDF24 Creator][30], where
all files remain on your PC.

### No installation necessary

PDF24's online tools work directly in the web browser. You do not need to install any software. This
means you can use the PDF24 tools on any device with an Internet connection.

### Supports your system

PDF24 supports all current operating systems and browsers. Whether on Windows, Linux, MACs or
smartphones, PDF24 does a good job almost everywhere.

### Saves your resources

The PDF24 Online Tools process files on special PDF24 servers. Your system is not burdened in the
process and therefore does not need any special requirements.

### 100% free of charge

You can use all PDF24 tools free of charge and without any restrictions. This is achieved via some
advertising on the web pages. PDF24 is not greedy, but smart.

### No limits

There are no artificial limits at PDF24. Thanks to our scalable infrastructure, we can make
everything that the PDF24 tools can do available to users.

### Online and Offline

PDF24's online tools process files on special PDF24 servers. If you prefer to work offline, you can
install the [PDF24 Creator][31] and receive all PDF24 tools as an offline version.
